Info

Factory service constructing StreamConfig domain models from settings or defaults.

class scarajectory.core.service.communication.stream.config_factory.ConfigFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing creation of StreamConfig parameter models.

It defines:

methods:
create - Constructs StreamConfig using explicit configuration parameters.
get_version - Returns factory version string.
classmethod create(*, port: str = '/dev/ttyUSB0', baudrate: int = 115200, timeout: float = 0.1, queue_capacity: int = 16, protocol_mode: ProtocolMode = ProtocolMode.BINARY) → StreamConfig[source]¶

Constructs and returns a StreamConfig instance with explicit parameters.

Parameters:

  • port – Communication port path or IP:port address.

  • baudrate – Baudrate frequency integer.

  • timeout – Communication timeout float.

  • queue_capacity – Ring buffer capacity integer.

  • protocol_mode – ProtocolMode enum (ASCII or BINARY).

Returns:

Configured StreamConfig model instance.

Exceptions:

None.

classmethod get_version() → str[source]¶

Returns the factory version string.

Returns:

Factory version string.
